name: QR Code Generator
title: Free QR Code Generator: URL, Wi-Fi and Email, PNG or SVG
description: Make QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi logins and email in your browser. Choose colors and error correction, and download PNG or SVG. No sign-up, no tracking redirect.
card: Make QR codes for links, Wi-Fi and email as PNG or SVG.
lede: Type a link or text, or fill in Wi-Fi or email details, and download a QR code as a PNG or a scalable SVG.
answer_q: How do I make a QR code for a link?
answer: Paste the full URL, including https://, then download the code as PNG for screens or SVG for print. The codes made here are static: they point straight at your link and never expire.
steps: Choose Link or text, Wi-Fi, or Email.
Pick error correction; Medium suits most uses, High if you will put a logo over it.
Keep dark modules on a light background for reliable scanning.
Download PNG or SVG and test-scan it before printing.

examples.title: Tracking scans
examples.text: To count scans in analytics, encode a link with UTM tags, for example `utm_medium=qr`. Build it with the [UTM builder](/utm-builder/) first.

SVG scales to any size without blur, which is best for print. PNG is easiest for slides, documents and websites.
Yes, but keep strong contrast and a darker foreground than background. Inverted or low-contrast codes fail on some scanners.

faq.q: Is my Wi-Fi password sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. The code is drawn in your browser. It is still readable by anyone who scans the printed code, so only share guest network details.
